_comment: Game UI points for a 2560x1080 CLIENT area (created 2026-09-24, scripts/gameio). On this device the game runs borderless full screen on the primary monitor at (0,0), so client pixels = screen pixels, and full-screen shots give client pixels directly. Every point states its provenance ('measured YYYY-MM-DD <how>', 'screenshot <file> ...', 'derived <how>'); sheets.Sheet.point refuses derived points unless allow_derived=True. A provenance that says 're-measure live' predates the 2026-09-10 build: probe it before any click relies on it. Points NOT entered, and why, are under _not_entered.

_layout.provenance: measured 2026-09-24 live/01_menu.png (the main session's full-resolution 2560x1080 capture of the post-September-patch home menu, 2026-09-24 12:02, game v100.19.18309.0; committed crops scripts/gameio/tests/fixtures/menu_20260924_*.png) by screens.is_main_menu's frame-line detector on column x=444: the first row of each 2-px frame line (253,228,163) with black outside - 18 lines, 9 buttons (Continue, Load, Campaign, Skirmish, Multiplayer, Home City, Scenario Editor, Options, Tools) at a 55 px pitch; 'buttons' = each button's frame rows, 'outline_x' = the black outline run above every top frame. Pixel-identical in the box 330-560 x 240-740 to the 2026-09-20 22:40 shot (fixture menu_20260920_col.png). screens.menu_layout_ok(img) requires these lines within tol_px before a menu click (python -m scripts.gameio menu <name> does): a shifted layout fails it - the 2026-08-26 menu had Skirmish one pitch lower, at y 490, which is Multiplayer now. Exit (y ~992-1028) is deliberately not a point.

skirmish.provenance: measured 2026-09-24 live/01_menu.png (post-September-patch home menu, full resolution; fixture menu_20260924_skirmish.png): the Skirmish label's glyph box (R > 150, G > 110, R - B > 60 inside the button) is x 403-485, y 429-441, centre (444.0, 435.0); (444,435) is a label pixel (212,181,104) - exactly the colour the 2026-08-26 probe (444,490) was calibrated to. 'also' = the top frame's second row (444,417). The same pixels on the 2026-09-20 22:40 shot. Not yet clicked live.

scenario_editor.provenance: measured 2026-09-24 live/01_menu.png (fixture menu_20260924_editor.png): the Scenario Editor label's glyph box is x 365-524, y 594-606, centre (444.5, 600.0). Column x=444 crosses the label only in 1-2 px strokes, so the probe is (440,600) (243,215,125), inside a 2-px glyph stroke (rows 599-602) 4.5 px left of the label centre; 'also' = the top frame's second row (444,582). The older click (444,599) - measured 2026-09-18 live (sandbox/census/editor_regen.py MENU_EDITOR; it opened the editor in the debugRandomMaps bisect boot loop) - lies in the same button (frame rows 581-618) on the plain fill (82,34,17).

tools.provenance: measured 2026-09-24 live/01_menu.png (fixture menu_20260924_col.png): (444,709) is a Tools label pixel (244,218,129); the label's glyph box is x 416-472, y 704-716, centre (444.0, 710.0), inside the button frame rows 691-728; 'also' = the top frame's second row (444,692). Never clicked.
